title: docs(skills): a clashing flow function name leaves the later package's functions and hooks unbound, not refused at install
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVyJcsmnrrm8h24VEcqmdWB)_

Fixes #33569

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Signed: domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mpzgKr4dbZVjCqjSv

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-automation` 技能「Valid-but-silently-wrong」第 3 条里,把「同一命名空间(或无命名空间)的第二个包声明同名流程函数会在安装时被拒」改成实际行为:启动时两包都已持有则告警 `Bare-name conflict at boot`;启动后再装的包照样装上,但它的绑定整体失败(`error` 日志 `Failed to bind declarative hooks`),它的所有函数和钩子都不生效,不冲突的那些也一样。补救办法不变:改名,或换一个命名空间。
- 为什么改:旧说法让作者以为会被响亮拒绝;实际是装上了却静默不工作,流程的 `script` 步骤要么因找不到函数而失败,要么(依赖了先持有的包时)悄悄跑了别人的函数。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字与一个 patch changeset,不碰 schema、运行时与 eval;回滚即还原本 PR。文件 token 仍在上限内(6861 / 6861),靠在同文件里缩短两处重复说明付账,未抬上限。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 第 263–279 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`,应只见第 3 条这一段与其后 `outputVariable` 一句的改动。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`),席位的达档契约复审 PASS 记录在案后,请合并。

## What changes

Item 3 of "Valid-but-silently-wrong" in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`. Old text: "Packages of two `namespace`s each run their own `normalize_phone` (one namespace, or none: refused at install; a boot warns `Bare-name conflict at boot`)." New text:

> Packages of two `namespace`s each run their own `normalize_phone`. One namespace (or none): both held at boot warn `Bare-name conflict at boot`; a later one installs but binds NONE of its functions or hooks (error `Failed to bind declarative hooks`): rename, or another namespace.

This is should-fix F1 of the at-tier retro review of merged PR #33396 (record 6886826237), with nit F3 folded in: the old parenthesis merged two moments, a pair both held at the boot and a new holder bound after it. The new sentence gives each its own clause.

### Each claim, read on `main` @ 7f0e38a2

| Claim | Code |
|:--|:--|
| Two namespaces each run their own (unchanged) | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:5520-5523` (`bareNameHoldersOtherThan` with `incomingNamespace`: a holder of another namespace is no conflict); `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts:753` (step 1, the caller package's own item) |
| Both held at boot: the boot warns `Bare-name conflict at boot` | Before the seal `claimBareNameFunctions` only records (`registry.ts:5517`, the throw is inside `if (this.bareNameHoldersSealed)`); the AppPlugin binds in `start()` (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:1413`, call at `:1865`) and the seal runs later at `kernel:bootstrapped` (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:1372-1383`), where `sealBareNameHoldersAtColdBoot` logs `bareNameColdBootWarning` (`registry.ts:3044`, text opens "Bare-name conflict at boot" at `:2957`) |
| A later one installs | The bind after the seal throws `BareNameConflictError` (`registry.ts:5530`) from `bindHooksToEngine` (`packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts:221`); `bindAppArtifactHandlers` catches it per owner group and logs it (`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts:415-443`, "Never throws" at `:89`), so neither caller sees a throw: AppPlugin `start()` (`app-plugin.ts:1865`) and the install-local plugin, which binds an installed package on install (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:6611-6615`) |
| ...but binds NONE of its functions or hooks | The claim runs ahead of every `registerFunction` (`hook-binder.ts:221` before `:236`) and ahead of the hook half (`:249` onward), so the throw leaves both empty for that owner group, the non-clashing names included. Pinned by `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-request-family.test.ts:586-602` (`beta_only_fn` stays unregistered) |
| (error `Failed to bind declarative hooks`) | `app-artifact-handlers.ts:442`, `logger.error` |
| What the author then sees (not written into the sentence; it follows from it and the next sentence) | Its flows read the clashing name as a package holding none: one holder only outside the `dependencies` closure refuses `outside-closure` as a guard (`package-scoped-resolution.ts:769-774`), a holder inside the closure runs that package's function (step 2, `:756-767`). A non-clashing name has no holder at all and fails as unregistered (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts:663-668`) |
| Remedy: rename, or another namespace | Rename: the boot warning's own remedy (`registry.ts:2960-2961`) and the card. Another namespace: two holders of different declared namespaces never meet, so the bind is not refused (`registry.ts:5520-5523`) |

### Token budget, paid in place

The file sat at 6859 of 6861 (priced bytes 27435). The rewrite costs +129 bytes, paid in the same file:

- The flow door clause "a flow door answers `400 FLOW_FAILED`, `error.details.innerRefusal` naming each holder" becomes "a flow door's `innerRefusal` names each holder". Home: `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:356-365` teaches the flow door's `400 FLOW_FAILED` and `error.details.innerRefusal`, naming a `script` node's function-name refusal.
- "(registered under no package)" becomes "ownerless", the word the file already uses for the same idea (§ Assignment rules).
- "(below)" after `defineStack({ functions })` is cut; the example sits right under it.
- The pure-compute paragraph's "`config.outputVariable` exposes that value as a flow variable, and a later declarative node persists it" becomes "a later declarative node persists its `outputVariable`"; the example under it shows `outputVariable: 'ai'` read as `ai.ai_category`. The eval that expects `outputVariable` (flows-triggers-approvals) is still served by that example.

Result: 27444 priced bytes, 6861 of 6861, headroom 0. Ceiling not moved. Lines: 463 before, 463 after. Package total of all SKILL.md files: unchanged in lines; tokens +2 (the file's headroom).

## Tests

Skill wording only: no package is touched, so no package test or typecheck is owed and no ablation applies. The claims are read against the code and the pinning test named above.

## Acceptance notes

- Code-side texts that use the same loose wording belong to the objectql owner and are NOT edited here (order ruling): `packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts:214-216` still says the function bind refusal "stays until the trailing backstop child (ADR-0150 D9) narrows it", which has narrowed (`bareNameHoldersOtherThan` with the namespace); `bareNameColdBootWarning` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2959-2960`) says "a further package declaring the name is refused at install", which for a function is the bind failure above. The seat files a card.
- `.changeset/32522-skills-automation-function-name-per-namespace.md`, still unreleased, carries the old "refused at install" sentence. It is not edited here (outside this card's surface); this PR's changeset states the correction, so both entries ship in the same release notes.
